class.name: NNBTRoot
class.brief_description: The main node for the Noodle Nodes Behaviour Tree nodes.
class.description: This is the main node for the Noodle Nodes Behaviour Tree nodes. The root node is ticked to update the state of the behaviour tree. The root must have exactly one enabled behaviour tree child. It ticks the first enabled child and returns that child's result. Any further enabled behaviour tree children are ignored; the first time the root is ticked with more than one enabled behaviour tree child it reports a one-time error. The editor shows a configuration warning for the same configuration. [NNSensors] child nodes are allowed in addition to the single behaviour tree child. Sensors do not count as behaviour tree children. If no behaviour tree child is enabled, or the root has no children at all, [method tick] returns [code]FAILURE[/code].

method.name: tick
method.description: This is the behaviour tree tick-method you should be using to tick the tree. You can provide any [Variant] type as a parameter (usually a node used as an actor or a dictionary used as a blackboard), along with a delta-time. These are passed to all the child nodes of the behaviour tree during ticks.

members.member: This is the total time in microseconds the call to the [method tick] method used.
